subject: Semiconductors, SpaceX, and Overlooked Opportunities

 Your October podcast roundup is here. Listen now. October Podcast Roundup 

   

 
 This month’s Investing Experts Podcast digs into Micron’s staying power, strategic investing, the latest AI rally, and more. Listen in for market analysis, fresh perspectives, and timely stock ideas. 

 
   
 
 
 S&P Hits All-Time Highs, AI Trade Does All The Work
 

 Guests: Seeking Alpha analysts Uttam Dey and Amrita Roy
 

 
 The AI-driven tech rally remains fundamentally sound, with robust earnings and accelerating AI/cloud revenues behind the wheel. Join tech analysts Uttam Dey and Amrita Roy for an insightful discussion about where this rally could go. They’ll also share which stocks they think are worth watching.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Don't Sleep On (Analog) Semiconductors
 

 
 Guest: Alex King, Growth Investor Pro 
 

 
 
 Join Alex King, Investing Group Leader of Growth Investor Pro, for a semiconductor deep dive into entry points, cycle risk, and negative retail sentiment. Tune in to find out which overlooked analog semis offer the most opportunity after a sector-wide sell-off.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   Being Picky With Stocks More Important Than Ever
 

 
 Guests: Seeking Alpha analysts Julia Ostian, Kenio Fontes, and Jack Bowman 
 

 
 Top analysts Julia Ostian, Kenio Fontes, and Jack Bowman talk AI hype and undervalued opportunity amid stretched valuations. Catch this episode and learn which tickers have the most potential in AI infrastructure, defense, and tech.
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Listen Now 
   SpaceX, Telecom Sell-Off, Micron's A Grades, Steve Cress Origin Story
 

 
 Guest: Steven Cress, VP of Quantitative Strategy at Seeking Alpha 
 

 
 SpaceX’s $8B deal sparked a sell-off in major telecom stocks, but investors might be jumping the gun. Listen in as Steven Cress shares his personal story and lays out Micron’s persistent strength, despite a handful of ongoing headwinds.
